claim: The input domain of the whole subset is fixed by the C++ type widths, not by the caller: date::year holds a short so year::min() is -32767, year::max() is 32767 and year::ok() rejects exactly the one value -32768, date::month and date::day hold unsigned char so month is 1..12 and day is 1..31, and the result type days::rep is a 32-bit int, over which to_days() stays within [-12687428, 11248737] and cannot overflow; every Creusot obligation in this cluster is therefore bounded by year in [-32767, 32767].
